html: † [דֹּ֫בֶר] n.[m.] pasture (cf. Aramaic דַּבְרָא, Syriac ܕܰܒܪܳܐ )—sf. כְּעֵדֶר בְּתוֹךְ הַדָּֽבְרוֹ as a flock in the midst of its pasture Mi 2:12 (art. with sf., cf. Ges§ 127, 4 b, who attaches ו as conj. to foll. word); וְרָעוּ כְבָשִׂים כְּדָבְרָם and lambs shall feed as (in) their pasture Is 5:17.
